source.prompt: Progressive house song, about 3.5 minutes, 126 BPM, E minor. Driving, hopeful late-night journey mood that builds and opens up. Clear, airy female lead vocal, close and emotive in the verses, soaring on the chorus with stacked harmonies. Pizzicato string and harp plucks in rolling arpeggios, clean electric guitar delay picking, warm Steinway piano chords, lush string section swells, rolling offbeat bass. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, 16th hats with accents, tambourine and ride on the drops. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and piano, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[verse]
Headlights paint the empty road
Every sign is pointing home
But I keep driving through the night
Chasing something out of sight

[pre-chorus]
Hold the wheel and hold your breath
There's a little more left
Don't look back, don't slow down

[chorus]
Further than the light
I can feel it pulling me tonight
Every mile is burning bright
Take me further than the light
Further than the light

[verse]
